profile_text.body:
Ericsson LM Telephone Co is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, trading under the ticker ERIC. On its website the company describes itself as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI-driven automation, cloud, and enterprise connectivity. It says its CTO writes about shifts shaping networks into what the company calls a programmable, autonomous and AI-native intelligent fabric, and it presents perspectives on 6G as an intelligent fabric connecting people and machines through mobile, cloud, and AI systems.

The site also covers network slicing, orchestration, and AI-driven tools for connectivity, and it discusses building trusted AI for networks. It cites AT&T's Open Radio Access Network (Open RAN) transformation as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network.

The company's profile lists it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0000717826. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
